playtime_definition: median playtime of owners, hours (SteamSpy estimate)
popularity_strata: fixed bands of total review count
caveats: SteamSpy only estimates playtime for games with enough owners; the sample is the popular slice of Steam (median 553 reviews vs 21 for games without an estimate).
median_playtime is a game-level summary of owners' playtime, not a player-level time-to-review measure: no player-level U-shape can be tested with this file.
Reviews are lifetime totals as of the snapshot, so rating mixes launch-window and late impressions.
Popularity (review count) and rating are not independent: quality raises both, and rating is the ratio of the two review counts.
